title: 第十五章 开启大阵
content_zh:
九重天上，南天门外束升大阵里面正有一群神仙，一眼望去，为首的是一个仙风道骨的老头，此人正是太白金星。

    “金星大人，要不您再考虑考虑”此时一个离太白金星较近的一个神仙开口了。

    “是啊，是啊，大人请你再三考虑啊”

    其他人见有人劝阻太白金星于是便都开口劝道。

    只是那太白金星仍旧继续做着开启束升大阵的准备工作。

    “噗通!噗通!噗通!”

    见劝说无果，在束升大阵内的神仙除了太白金星都纷纷下跪，更有些人竟抱着太白金星的腿开始哭了起来，那哭的甚是凄惨，鼻涕一把泪一把，不知情的人还以为他家里出什么事了呢。

    面对这阵仗，就连太白金星也是为之一愣不知如何是好。

    远远一望，此时的场景非常壮观。

    “让他用!”

    忽然在束升大阵外传来了一道声音，这声音是如此的威严，如此的洪亮。

    虽然只是简简单单几个字，但这声音却威慑力十足，让人听了就感到生畏。

    先前还苦苦哀求太白金星不要开启大阵的几个神仙听到此声，先是为之一颤竟真的停止劝阻太白金星了。

    他们几个纷纷站了起来，低头不语，从这就可以看出这个男人说话的分量是如此之重!
content_en:
After listening to the stone's explanation, Li Lei couldn't help but sigh. He lamented that the world of cultivating immortals is really complicated and there is no end to learning!

"Do you want to practice this ghost elixir?" Shitou asked.

"I don't know. Let's take a look. Take one step at a time. Besides, it's not certain whether you can reach the realm of heaven."

"You are really promising"

Hearing what Li Lei said, Shitou was also speechless.

Suddenly, Li Lei's eyes turned to two other treasures, a mutilated book and a gourd that exuded a strange aura.

To be precise, this incomplete book can't be called a book at all, because this book, regardless of whether it is complete or not, has made Li Lei very disgusted by its appearance.

I saw that this book was full of dust. The dust was so thick that it was almost caked up, completely covering the appearance of the book. Even if there was still some remaining parts of the book, the corners of the book were rotten and wrinkled like a rag. There were even missing parts that seemed to have been torn out. Moreover, the book exuded a very unpleasant musty smell.

"Are you sure this is a treasure? What a crappy book!"

Li Lei was shocked when he saw this book. If this book did not appear in the Qiankun Bag but appeared somewhere else, Li Lei would definitely treat it as trash and avoid it. Now that it is here, Li Lei wants to use this trash as a treasure.

"Don't talk nonsense if you don't understand! This is really a treasure, don't be ignorant," Shitou retorted excitedly.

It can be seen that this book is really important to Shitou. Otherwise, how could Shitou be so excited after hearing what Li Lei said?

"Ouch"

Shitou sighed helplessly and then said: "Forget it, you are a bumpkin, I will not care about you anymore."

"Hey! Thank you, Queen." Li Lei flattered Shitou when he saw him like this.

So Shitou began to tell Li Lei about the origin of this book.

This book is a fragment of "Pictures of the Dead"!

"The Diagram of the Dead" is a god-level technique of the Rakshasa clan, one of the ten clans in the hell world. It was created by the demon ancestor Rahu and is one of the world-regulating treasures of the demon world.

Although this is only a fragment of the scroll, it can be practiced. However, other fragments of the scroll need to be found to be put together in the future. Just this fragment of the scroll can cause uproar in the three realms. It can be seen how powerful and rare the "Death Map" is. It is really helpful to the current Li Lei.

Demon Ancestor, a forbidden ancient god of the Rakshasa tribe in the demon world, whose real name is "Rahu", is known as the three major sources of demons along with the Heavenly Demon and the Great Demon God.
